title: Enter does not fire inside textareas - multiline note editing works normally
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. A shift's detail modal is open with the note editor active.
steps: 1. Type a line of note text and press Enter.
expected: 1. Enter inserts a new line in the note - it does NOT confirm/close the dialog.
2. The multiline note can be completed and saved normally.
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
